sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 release is the only concrete in-window event, positioning the Chinese lab's open-source push as the day's dominant story.

sections.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3, billed as the world's largest open-source model
sections.content: Moonshot AI released the Kimi K3 model, described in coverage as the 'world's largest open-source model,' with the launch tied to WAIC spotlighting Chinese AI capabilities.
sections.significance: A frontier-scale open-source release from a Chinese lab, framed as the largest open-source model to date, intensifying the open-weights competition among Chinese AI developers.

sections.title: Rumors and Unverified Claims
sections.content: The Kimi K3 release is reported only via a Google News aggregation item; no authoritative or independent corroborating source is supplied.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Watch for primary confirmation from Moonshot AI or independent technical evaluation of Kimi K3, and for competitive responses from other open-weights labs.
